description: This file defines the OrganizationsMembershipService class, which manages organization memberships including CRUD operations, permission checks, and user addition validation within an organization. It interacts with repositories, output services, and external services related to OAuth clients and delegation credentials.

classes.name: OrganizationsMembershipService
classes.description: Service class managing organization memberships, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and permission checks.

methods.name: getOrgMembership
methods.description: Retrieves a specific organization membership by organization and membership IDs.

methods.name: isOrgAdminOrOwner
methods.description: Checks if a user has admin or owner role within an organization.

methods.name: getOrgMembershipByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a user's membership details within an organization.

methods.name: getPaginatedOrgMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of organization memberships.

methods.name: deleteOrgMembership
methods.description: Deletes an organization membership and removes the user from the organization team.

methods.name: createOrgMembership
methods.description: Creates a new organization membership and ensures user calendars if email is available.

methods.name: canUserBeAddedToOrg
methods.description: Validates if a user can be added to an organization based on OAuth client associations.
